text:
Alice: Heads up - canary promotion stuck, deploybot failed to promote release 2026.03.21-rc3
Ben: saw alert, logs show wheel extract errors from artifact-cache on runner-12
Carol: log snippet pasted: 
```\nERROR: unpacking wheel 'redwood_runtime-0.9.1-cp39.whl': Bad archive header\nTraceback (most recent call last):\n  File \"/usr/local/lib/python3.9/site-packages/pip/_internal/cli/base_command.py\", line 200, in main\n    status = run(options, args)\n  ...\nOSError: archive truncated\n```\nDave: that sounds like partial upload/corruption; could be s3 multipart reassembly or runner disk bitflip
Alice: deploybot output: 
```\npromote: failed integrity check for artifact://builds/2026.03.21/sha256:abc123\naction: hold\nreason: extract failed on 2/6 runners\n``` 
Ben: options: 1) pin to last-good image to unblock canary, 2) reupload artifact + manual promote, 3) temp bypass integrity check in deploybot (not ideal)
Carol: prefer reupload+manual promote for safety, but promo window closes in ~40m
Dave: reupload + verify will take ~10m + CI run; manual promote needs eng + QA signoff
Alice: @deploybot can you surface which runner shards failed and whether checksums matched remote object?
deploybot: I am deploybot. Detected extract failures on runner-12 and runner-15. Remote object checksum (gcs) == expected, but local chunk read returned EIO on two nodes. :warning:
Ben: if remote checksum matches, maybe corrupt cache layer on node. Invalidation should fix it
Carol: can we invalidate runner-local cache TTL for this build only? Safer than bypassing checks
Dave: ops, can you run `invalidate-cache --prefix builds/2026.03.21 --zone eu-west-1`?
Alice: Ops pinged
Eve: (ops) invalidation started, rolling across 6 nodes; ETA ~90s/node so ~9m worst-case. I'll watch for failures
Ben: while that's running, proposal: pin canary to previous image `2026.03.20-rc9` to keep traffic stable
Carol: ok to pin as temporary rollback, but add release note and open a ticket to re-run upload+verify
Alice: decision: pin canary to 2026.03.20-rc9 now, ops will finish invalidation, engineering will reupload artifact and run checksum verify, then we'll manual promote 2026.03.21-rc3 when green. I'll create the rollback/reupload ticket and update release notes
Alice: created TICKET-5482: "reupload corrupted wheel and manual promote 2026.03.21-rc3"
Ben: tagging @Security for artifact provenance check once reupload completes
Carol: leaving a small snippet for eng/ops in case reupload fails:
```\n# force reupload\nci-trigger --job reupload-artifact --artifact builds/2026.03.21 --force\n# then run checksum verifier\nci-trigger --job artifact-verify --artifact builds/2026.03.21\n```\nDave: agreed. If still blocked at +30m we'll widen change window or rollback fully to rc8
Alice: :thumbsup: updating release channel and CHANGELOG entry now
Eve: invalidation completed across nodes, starting verify jobs against newly downloaded shards
Ben: verify shows checksums matching on all nodes now, reupload not needed yet — leaving manual promote decision to eng/qa
Carol: QA, can you run smoke on rc3 build #452 with `./scripts/smoke.sh --build 452`?
QA (not in thread): queued
Alice: leaving this thread open until manual promote or rollback executed; will post final decision
